items.source: InvalidPropertyException - if there is no such property or if the property isn't writable
items.translation: InvalidPropertyException - 如果不存在该属性或该属性不可写

items.source: PropertyBatchUpdateException - if one or more PropertyAccessExceptions occurred for specific properties during the batch update. This exception bundles all individual PropertyAccessExceptions. All other properties will have been successfully updated.
items.translation: PropertyBatchUpdateException - 如果在批量更新期间针对特定属性发生了一个或多个 PropertyAccessException，则抛出此异常。此异常封装了所有单独的 PropertyAccessException。其他所有属性均已成功更新。

items.source:
Marker that indicates the start of a property key for an
indexed or mapped property like "person.addresses[0]".
items.translation: 标记指示索引或映射属性（如"person.addresses[0]"）的属性键的起始位置。

items.source:
Marker that indicates the end of a property key for an
indexed or mapped property like "person.addresses[0]".
items.translation: 标记指示索引或映射属性（如"person.addresses[0]"）的属性键的结束位置。

items.source: Set the specified value as current property value.
items.translation: 将指定值设置为当前属性值。

items.source: propertyName - the property to check (may be a nested path and/or an indexed/mapped property)
items.translation: propertyName - 要检查的属性（可以是嵌套路径和/或索引/映射属性）

items.source: Note that performing a batch update differs from performing a single update, in that an implementation of this class will continue to update properties if a recoverable error (such as a type mismatch, but not an invalid field name or the like) is encountered, throwing a PropertyBatchUpdateException containing all the individual errors. This exception can be examined later to see all binding errors. Properties that were successfully updated remain changed.
items.translation: 请注意，执行批量更新与执行单个更新不同：如果在此类方法的实现中遇到可恢复的错误（例如类型不匹配，但不是无效字段名等），该实现将继续更新属性，并抛出一个包含所有单独错误的PropertyBatchUpdateException。稍后可以通过检查此异常来查看所有绑定错误。已成功更新的属性将保持更改状态。

items.source:
Path separator for nested properties.
Follows normal Java conventions: getFoo().getBar() would be "foo.bar".
items.translation: 嵌套属性的路径分隔符。遵循正常的 Java 约定：getFoo().getBar() 对应 "foo.bar"。

items.source: PropertyAccessException - if the property was valid but the accessor method failed
items.translation: PropertyAccessException - 如果属性有效但访问器方法失败

items.source: pvs - a PropertyValues to set on the target object
items.translation: pvs - 要设置到目标对象上的属性值

items.source: Bulk updates from PropertyValues are more powerful: This method is provided for convenience. Behavior will be identical to that of the setPropertyValues(PropertyValues) method.
items.translation: 来自 PropertyValues 的批量更新功能更强大：此方法是为了方便而提供的。其行为与setPropertyValues(PropertyValues)方法完全相同。

items.source: Returns false if the property doesn't exist.
items.translation: 如果属性不存在，则返回false。

items.source: Path separator for nested properties.
items.translation: 嵌套属性的路径分隔符。

items.source:
Determine the property type for the specified property,
either checking the property descriptor or checking the value
in case of an indexed or mapped element.
items.translation: 确定指定属性的属性类型，要么检查属性描述符，要么在针对索引或映射元素时检查值。

items.source:
Return a type descriptor for the specified property:
preferably from the read method, falling back to the write method.
items.translation: 返回指定属性的类型描述符：首选从读取方法，其次回退到写入方法。

items.source: Get the current value of the specified property.
items.translation: 获取指定属性的当前值。

items.translation: PropertyAccessException - 如果属性有效但访问器方法失败或发生类型不匹配

items.source: the property type for the particular property, or null if not determinable
items.translation: 该特定属性的属性类型，或如果无法确定则为null。

items.source: propertyName - the name of the property to get the value of (may be a nested path and/or an indexed/mapped property)
items.translation: propertyName - 要获取其值的属性名称（可以是嵌套路径和/或索引/映射属性）

items.source: propertyName - the name of the property to set the value of (may be a nested path and/or an indexed/mapped property)
items.translation: propertyName - 要设置其值的属性名称（可以是嵌套路径和/或索引/映射属性）

items.source: ignoreUnknown - should we ignore unknown properties (not found in the bean)
items.translation: ignoreUnknown - 是否应忽略未知属性（在 Bean 中未找到）

items.source: Serves as base interface for BeanWrapper.
items.translation: 作为BeanWrapper的基础接口。

items.source: Does not allow unknown fields or invalid fields.
items.translation: 不允许未知字段或无效字段。

items.translation: 执行批量更新的首选方式。

items.source: Perform a batch update with more control over behavior.
items.translation: 执行具有更严格行为控制的批量更新。

items.source: Perform a batch update with full control over behavior.
items.translation: 执行具有完全行为控制的批量更新。

items.translation: pv - 包含新属性值的对象

items.source: map - a Map to take properties from. Contains property value objects, keyed by property name

items.translation: ignoreInvalid - 是否应忽略无效属性（已发现但不可访问）
